Definition: adverb from G4705; earnestly, promptly:--diligently, instantly.
BiblicalUsage: Diligently is the word for earnest haste in a good cause. The elders besought Jesus instantly for the centurion, Onesiphorus sought Paul out very diligently in Rome and found him, and Titus is told to bring Zenas and Apollos on their journey diligently, that nothing be wanting unto them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe diligence in the gospel is love with its sleeves up, and Onesiphorus searching Rome for a prisoner is the picture.
